entries.title: Highrise City
entries.definitive_edition: Highrise City Complete Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Complete Edition with Metro & Planes and Vacation Season DLC
primary.why: Highrise City is a Windows PC release on Steam, and its Complete Edition bundle contains the base game plus the Metro & Planes and Vacation Season gameplay DLC. That makes Windows PC the only sourced platform and the most complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC Steam release, preferably via the Complete Edition bundle or with Metro & Planes and Vacation Season installed.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with Steam Workshop support and optional gameplay DLC.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release platform and complete package is available on PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform split was found; completeness is handled by installing the gameplay DLC on Windows PC.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Complete Edition is a bundle with DLC, not a remaster. Add Metro & Planes and Vacation Season for the most complete gameplay package.
